product_one_liner.value: Marquee is an AI-powered football intelligence platform for professional clubs that unifies club and market data to support recruitment, squad planning, and tactical decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: Product pages describe its football recruitment, squad, and tactical intelligence capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs visitors to book a demo and provides no pricing page/link.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly identified as club partners/customers in Marquee announcements.

employee_band.notes: Available company-profile data reports 1–10 employees, outside the requested bands; no credible source found supporting any listed band.

hq_location.notes: Company profile identifies Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.

founded_year.notes: Startup Nation Finder gives December 2025; LinkedIn lists founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: News index shows company/product articles, partnerships, events and funding announcements, not a technical engineering blog with two qualifying posts.

public_docs.notes: Site links to a product FAQ, but has no public documentation/help center or developer portal link; its FAQ is product information rather than a multi-article docs site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Marquee's LinkedIn company result advertises a Senior AI Scientist opening.

model_provider.notes: Product, FAQ, news and available security information mention proprietary AI/ML models but do not publicly name an underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Marquee publicly states it completed a SOC 2 Type II audit/verification; no other listed certification was found.

last_funding.notes: The company announced $6.5M total funding in July 2026; Startup Nation Finder states $6.5M across two rounds and the earlier pre-seed was $2M, implying a $4.5M latest seed.

raised_18mo.notes: Marquee announced the funding round on July 30, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current SDR/AE job board or careers listing could not be verified.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable news index's most recent item is dated October 21, 2026, within the six-month window, but it is an editorial/product explainer, not a new product or major feature launch; no launch-type item in the window was identified.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The about page's full listed team includes founding leadership and other named staff, and the news index shows no leadership join/departure announcement in the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company LinkedIn job/contact listing signal identifies HubSpot as a system in use.
